MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable fits my history of connecting computer equipment, especially my DVI cable purchase, although I would need a specific HDMI connection to make before buying it.",
    "The USB external drive has some relevance to my practical computer accessory purchases, but I would only consider it when I need more backup space."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Dot, streaming sticks and smart plug serve entertainment or home automation needs that my computer connectivity purchases do not suggest.",
    "Buying a tablet mount does not mean I need a replacement tablet, and the memory card is not useful to me without a compatible device that needs more storage.",
    "The optical audio cable resembles my past cable purchase on the surface, but it solves a home audio connection problem I have not indicated."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat interest in computer accessories as interest in electronic devices generally.",
    "A past tablet accessory purchase seems to have been stretched into interest in tablets themselves."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My WiFi adapter, USB expansion card and USB Ethernet adapter point toward solving specific computer connection and port needs.",
    "My purchases are infrequent and tied to particular uses; even a relevant cable or drive needs to solve a current problem before I would choose it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in computer accessories but extend it too broadly into entertainment devices and home automation."
}
